The multi-doser is powder-doser's chain carousel v5: an A&D HR-202i, 220 g to 0.1 mg, stands on the tray under the dose point, inside the doser's base and touching nothing of it, and the dose falls straight into the cup on its pan, weighed as it doses. No funnel and no load cell: our shuttle sets each cup on our pedestal on the pan, its 12.7 mm bore under the 8 mm stream, and only the cup touches the powder.

The UR10e takes an empty 5N Al cup from the rack, level, and sets it on the fork of our shuttle outside the doser (no gripper fits past v5's frame posts to the balance). Our pusher slides the HR-202i's -y side door back and the shuttle sets the cup on our pedestal on the pan, its rim 153 mm under the auger's exit.
